Chapter 1417 - 3: The Birth Of A New Source World

Chapter 1417: Chapter 3: The Birth of a New Source World

Inside the Time-Space Shop, the twelve-eyed beast looked apologetically at Lin Yuan: "Ye Wu is just like that, please don’t mind."

"I certainly don’t mind."

Lin Yuan said.

The negotiation with Lord Ye Wu didn’t go well, neither side was very satisfied; it’s quite normal.

In fact, if Lin Yuan were indeed an ordinary new Third Realm lord, he might have agreed.

Only serving for millions or tens of millions of years to get ten thousand pounds of time sands? Definitely not a loss.

As for the risks? Lin Yuan didn’t even need to think to know there are some risks in Wanwei space-time, but as a Time Lord, his ability to stay alive is quite strong, plus the compensation mentioned by Lord Ye Wu.

The ’offer’ is actually quite good.

But unfortunately, Lin Yuan is not a newly appointed Time Lord.

His current strength surpasses that of ordinary lords, and after fifty thousand or a hundred thousand years, it will soar even further.

To only get ten thousand pounds of time sands in exchange for Lin Yuan’s service for millions or tens of millions of years?

"That’s good then."

The twelve-eyed beast looked at Lin Yuan, its seventh eye blurry, reflecting Lin Yuan’s vague past and future.

"Already a lord, but why are there still traces of diverging timelines?" The twelve-eyed beast was slightly puzzled internally.

Time Lords are very cautious about their own timelines, they will try hard to conceal them, and since here is the past time-space, it’s even more impossible to glimpse any timelines.

But the twelve-eyed beast has many special talents, and though it couldn’t observe Lin Yuan’s timeline, it still perceived that the timeline hadn’t completely converged.

Time Lords generally have already completely converged their own timelines.

As for those like Lin Yuan whose timeline hasn’t converged? There aren’t many possibilities.

For example, practicing a certain secret technique that specifically causes a previously converged timeline to diverge again, to plan for more possible futures.

Or perhaps doing it deliberately, scattering multiple timelines to conceal the true timeline, and so on.

Though these possibilities exist, they are all acts of those extremely powerful and terrifying lords, and Lin Yuan, such a newly appointed Time Lord? It stands to reason he shouldn’t easily diverge his timeline like this.

"No matter what, focus on forming a good relationship." The twelve-eyed beast thought secretly.

It has encountered many Time Lords, but such a unique one as Lin Yuan is rare, naturally unwilling to offend.

Earlier it specifically reminded Lord Ye Wu outside, suggesting to offer more time sands to ’hire’ Lin Yuan, also considering this aspect, but unfortunately, Lord Ye Wu did not perceive its meaning.

Or maybe the Lord of Ye Wu did perceive, but simply didn’t care.

Among the many Time Lords, the Lord of Ye Wu is considered quite ’flamboyant’ in character.

"Any intelligence on Wanwei space-time?"

Lin Yuan asked.

He was now interested in Wanwei space-time, the strength of Lord Wanwei was definitely the most powerful Time Lord he had encountered, having passed the two-billionth tribulation of the ’Infinite Tribulation’ third tier stage!

The difficulty of each tribulation on the ’Infinite Tribulation’ path supersedes the previous, the two-billionth tribulation on the third stage? Lin Yuan couldn’t even imagine how to get through such a tribulation.

"There is."

The twelve-eyed beast smiled and said: "Complete intelligence is one thousand pounds of time sands, but I’ll charge you less, five hundred pounds of time sands."

"Okay."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Five hundred pounds of time sands to acquire complete Wanwei space-time intelligence is indeed not expensive, considering it involves such a being as Lord Wanwei.

Because the Wanwei space-time has been opened many times, much intelligence is no longer secret, otherwise the price would be thousands or even tens of thousands times higher.

Very soon.

Lin Yuan received a wealth of intelligence about Wanwei space-time.

"What do you think? Do you want to wait a bit? Ten thousand pounds of time sands is really a bit less, there should be other lords who can offer more."

The twelve-eyed beast said.

The Lord of Ye Wu is only willing to offer ten thousand pounds of time sands, but that doesn’t mean other Time Lords can’t offer more.

The twelve-eyed beast thought that with its ’connections’, it could secure a good price for Lin Yuan.

"Forget it."

Lin Yuan shook his head.

Even if the time sands can be increased from the base of ten thousand pounds, how much could they increase? Twelve thousand pounds? Fifteen thousand pounds?

Even if the twelve-eyed beast speaks its utmost, in the eyes of other lords, Lin Yuan is only a newly appointed lord.

They wouldn’t offer too many time sands.

Unless Lin Yuan is willing to reveal his true realm, but doing so would expose his secrets, attracting attention from much stronger lords, which would be counterproductive.

"If Your Excellency plans to explore Wanwei space-time alone, you need to be cautious of other lords."

The twelve-eyed beast could see Lin Yuan’s thoughts and reminded: "Lord Wanwei doesn’t have much malice towards future lords, and even if there are dangers in the Wanwei space-time he has opened, they won’t affect the mind or consciousness, but other lords might be different."

In the Wanwei space-time, there are numerous treasures and rarities that are enough to drive Time Lords insane; once multiple lords fight over a certain treasure, there won’t be any holding back.

A Time Lord is very hard to truly kill, but when facing an extremely powerful lord, being left with some indelible influence is still possible.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

"If you really encounter some enemy, you can use my name, as long as it doesn’t involve the legendary lords, it should be useful."

The twelve-eyed beast thought for a moment and then spoke.

It had already reached the final dozens of tribulations on the second stage of the Infinite Tribulation and its strength was quite renowned among the Third Realm lords, unless facing the legendary Time Lords of the third stage, no one would choose to offend it.
